items.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Argon reaches general availability in the Gemini API
items.summary: Google expanded access to Gemini 4 Argon, its frontier model, making it generally available via the Gemini API with a roughly 1M-token context window and introductory pricing of $2/M input and $10/M output tokens through November 30. It had previously been limited to a trusted group of cybersecurity partners.

items.headline: xAI launches Grok Voice 3.0, a new speech-to-speech model for voice agents
items.summary: xAI released Grok Voice 3.0 as the new default behind its Voice Agent API, aimed at phone support, contact centers and in-app assistants; it reports sub-one-second latency and topped Artificial Analysis's Speech-to-Speech Index at launch.

items.headline: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full for agentic coding
items.summary: Meta's new Muse Wonder models, available via its Model API and the Muse Code coding agent, pushed coding-agent benchmark scores up sharply versus the prior Muse Spark model, with Wonder Full reportedly matching Anthropic's Claude Code on Artificial Analysis's Coding Agent Index.

items.headline: NVIDIA expands Nemotron family with Super VL and Bolt models
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter open vision-language model it says completes multimodal agent tasks about five times faster than comparable models, alongside smaller efficiency-focused Bolt models for memory-constrained deployment.

items.headline: Liquid AI releases open-weight LFM2.5-24B-A2B mixture-of-experts model
items.summary: Liquid AI open-sourced LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter mixture-of-experts reasoning model with only ~2B active parameters per token, which the company claims is competitive with the larger Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on several agentic benchmarks.

items.headline: Google opens Deep Review, an AI tool for checking technical documents, to the public
items.summary: Google Research made Deep Review publicly available for flagging mathematical errors, logical gaps and unsupported claims in papers and other technical documents, following pilots on more than 15,000 manuscripts; the free tier allows two reviews per week.

items.headline: Anthropic updates Claude usage policy to ban persistent, purposeless cruelty toward the AI
items.summary: Anthropic announced a policy change, effective November 12, that lets it end conversations where users are repeatedly and gratuitously abusive to Claude with no discernible purpose, while explicitly excluding ordinary frustration, dark creative fiction, and legitimate testing or research.

items.headline: Rockefeller Foundation and OpenAI Foundation launch $50M program to bring AI to city services
items.summary: The two foundations announced a joint $50 million initiative offering grants of $500,000 to $2 million to help city governments use AI to improve public services, with applications open from October 14 through November 29.

items.headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-Live-1.1 and a smaller 'Quip' model to ChatGPT Voice
items.summary: OpenAI began a gradual rollout of GPT-Live-1.1 across ChatGPT, Codex and Dots, adding 13 new voices and more natural accents in languages including French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean and Japanese, alongside a lighter Quip variant succeeding GPT-Live-1 mini.

items.headline: MBZUAI and Inception42 launch Jais 3, a family of open Arabic-native AI models
items.summary: The Jais 3 family spans six open models from 900M to 375B parameters plus a dedicated Arabic speech-recognition model, trained on Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects; the developers say the flagship model leads open models on agentic tasks in Arabic.
